summary: Frontend-only verification after loader-hang fix. Logged in with admin (email+password+TOTP MFA) successfully. Verified /developers ('API & Subscribe form'), /branding, /integrations, and Campaign Analytics for a Sent campaign all load fully (well beyond the ~4s min gate, checked at ~7-9s) and show real content — none are stuck on the 'Loading API access…' bear loader. Simulation-mode banner and SMTP config form intact.
critical_code_review_comments: Product tour (driver.js) overlay on /campaigns intercepts pointer events and blocks clicks even for automation. It only disappears after explicit close click. Consider auto-dismissing on first ESC or route change to reduce friction (minor).

The /developers (ApiAccess), /branding, /analytics pages now correctly stop the loader on fetch failure (`failed` state + error card + Retry). Global 401 interceptor in lib/api.js also redirects to /login. Robustness fix looks correct.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: fill email+password, click 'Sign in', then input 6-digit TOTP into input[placeholder='000000'] and click 'Verify'. On /campaigns a product tour appears; dismiss via .driver-popover-close-btn before clicking data-testid='analytics-<id>'. Campaign analytics route: /campaigns/<id>/analytics. Loader has a min ~4s gate — never call something stuck before ~6s.
rca of the issue: Original bug: pages used useLoadingGate(!!data) and swallowed fetch errors with .catch, so loader never turned off if the request failed (e.g. 401 with expired token). Fix: added `failed` state, gate=!!data||failed, error card with Retry; and added a global axios 401 interceptor to clear session and redirect to /login. Verified: pages render content after fresh login and do not hang.
